details:
I have been actively involved in the VRChat community for quite some time, contributing to moderation and platform safety efforts. Over the past six months, I have noticed recurring issues with Trust & Safety reports involving evidence presented in languages other than English. In particular, videos, screenshots, and other submitted materials may contain important information that is difficult to understand due to language barriers.

I believe VRChat's Trust & Safety Team would benefit from implementing and improving multilingual translation capabilities to support the review of submitted evidence. This could include translating written content within screenshots, identifying and transcribing spoken dialogue in videos, and providing translation support for other forms of submitted evidence. These improvements could help the Trust & Safety Team better understand reported incidents, evaluate evidence more efficiently, and ensure that language differences do not prevent important information from being properly considered.

I also believe VRChat would benefit from greater developer engagement with different areas of the community. Creating better opportunities for community members, creators, and other contributors to communicate feedback, raise platform-related concerns, and share suggestions could help identify areas that need improvement. I would particularly like to see localization efforts extend beyond standard interface-string translations (etc.), with greater consideration given to broader language accessibility and the needs of VRChat's international community.

I am sharing these recommendations based on my experience contributing to community moderation and safety efforts, with the intention of identifying opportunities for improvement. I believe stronger multilingual support within Trust & Safety and better communication between the development team and the community could make a meaningful difference in the platform's accessibility, safety, and continued development. I hope these suggestions will be considered as potential improvements for VRChat moving forward.
title: Multilingual Trust & Safety Operations and Expanded Developer Engagement
